clusters.label: Research → content feedback loop
clusters.capability: Turn research and performance signals into repeatable content ideas without staring at a blank page.
signals: specialised agents can divide research, performance review and idea generation
a shared memory/second-brain layer makes later recommendations better
start with one agent before expanding the system

clusters.label: AI business operating system
clusters.capability: Give AI durable business context, separate workstreams and useful feedback so it can support a one-person or small business coherently.
signals: business context and memory matter more than a pretty dashboard
separate venture/context, workstreams, learning and customer/business data
security, permissions and isolation are core system design concerns

clusters.label: Always-on AI assistants
clusters.capability: Keep a narrowly defined AI job running without depending on the operator's laptop or memory to start it.
signals: running an orchestrator continuously is attractive to solo operators
technical hosting/setup complexity is a real implementation cost
the business-facing lesson is continuity and boundaries, not VPS configuration

clusters.label: Independent AI review
clusters.capability: Use a separate reviewer/checker to catch errors the AI that created the work may miss.
signals: separate AI sessions can divide build, preparation and review roles
an independent reviewer can be useful precisely because it does not share the builder's context
experimental tool mechanics should not be the public-facing promise
